OPENING DRIVE
THE WEEK THE UNDERDOGS STRUCK BACK.
Week 5 reminded us why this league works. The standings matter, but the kingdom never moves in a straight line. This was a week for resistance, for disruption, and for the owners who refused to stay where the record said they belonged.

Three teams entered the week at 1–3 and all three answered the call. Dr. Duckhook brought down D0nkey K0ng in the biggest visual statement of the slate. Seven Deadly Chins rolled into Slob’s territory, endured the mud, and came out laughing on the other side. The LLC didn’t just win — it posted the highest score of the week and turned the swamp into a live frontier.

Meanwhile, ObiWan Jacoby kept climbing. The Trade Jedi left Week 5 alone at 4–1, giving the league a clear leader even as the rest of the field tightened around him. His Majesty’s Blood defended the belt, Chili held Main Street, and seven teams now sit packed together at 2–3.

So before the roads split again, this is the truth of Week 5: the map changed. Power shifted. Pressure rose. And the teams that had been counted out were the ones that pushed the story forward.

Matchup I
CHAMPIONS’ JOUST
RED LEOPARDS vs OBIWAN JACOBY
ENTERING WEEK 5: BOTH TEAMS 3–1
VENUE: RED RUINS TOURNAMENT YARD
RED RUINS

The Red Ruins never disappoint.
As the sun sinks and the torches rise, two 3–1 contenders ride into the tournament yard. The Red Leopards, fierce and unrelenting, enter with the pride of a kingdom behind them. Across the stones, ObiWan Jacoby arrives with the calm resolve of a seasoned challenger, carrying the weight of a galaxy’s expectations.

The crowd roars. Banners ripple. Drums shake the cliffs.
This is more than a matchup — it’s a meeting of two powerful teams with identical records, each battle-tested, each believing this is their moment. The Red Ruins, with its towering gates and thousand voices, sets the stage for a contest that has the league watching. Two contenders. One field. And a joust that promises brilliance, grit, and no shortage of drama.

pages.title: The Collision
pages.text:
Page 6
MATCHUP I
THE COLLISION
OBIWAN JACOBY TAKES THE JOUST
RED RUINS

The charge was thunder, the impact inevitable.
Before a roaring Red Ruins crowd, ObiWan Jacoby found the lane, lowered his lance, and broke through. The Red Leopard never had a chance. In a single, decisive strike, ObiWan sent his rival from the saddle, shattering the Red banner and silencing the yard.

Both teams entered Week 5 at 3–1, but in the end it was ObiWan Jacoby who stood tall. With a commanding 154.42 to 110.42 victory, ObiWan rides away at 4–1, proving his vision and discipline once again. The Red Leopards, valiant in their home yard, are handed a rare defeat, falling to 3–2.

In the Red Ruins, spectacle met substance. The crowd came for a battle — and they got one. But when the dust settled, there could be only one victor. ObiWan Jacoby turned a clash of contenders into a statement, moving forward with momentum as the tournament continues.

WEEK 5

THE BOARD IS THE WORLD
TWO VISIONS. ONE BOARD. EVERYTHING ON IT.
GREAT MATCHUPS BUILD GREATER LEGENDS.
FANTASY LIVES HERE.
“You get a few wins and suddenly you’re a genius? Prove it.” — HMB

HIS MAJESTY’S BLOOD
THREE DREADED SNAKE

The board is bigger this week.
Under the moonlit heights of the Compact Neutral Grounds, two forces collide — a reigning champion and a rising disruptor, a crown and three heads, power and perception, legacy and legitimacy. His Majesty’s Blood arrives with silence, steel, and standards. Three Dreaded Snake shows up with swagger, schemes, and receipts waiting to be written.

This isn’t just another matchup.
It’s a statement.
In Week 5, the chessboard becomes a warboard. Every move matters. Every read is a message. Every lineup is a claim to the throne. In the Compact Neutral Grounds, reputations are tested, narratives are challenged, and the fantasy world watches to see whose vision holds.

Different styles. Same obsession. The board is the world.

pages.text:
WEEK 5 • GAME OF THE WEEK • PAGE 10
THE SACRIFICE
EVERY MOVE COSTS SOMETHING.
HIS MAJESTY’S BLOOD

“The board doesn’t lie. You give something up to take control.” — HMB
“One bad move can unravel everything. And he’s making us pay for it.” — TDS

THE MOMENT THE BOARD TILTED.
His Majesty’s Blood made the first real sacrifice of the night — giving up a piece to open the board. It wasn’t a loss. It was a statement. With the lane clear, HMB seized the initiative, dictating tempo and forcing Three Dreaded Snake into a desperate response. The counter came, but it stumbled. What looked like a calculated reply quickly turned into a costly mistake, and the momentum shifted firmly in HMB’s favor.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba 23.90

THE COSTLY COUNTER (THREE DREADED SNAKE)

A disastrous reply at the worst time.
While HMB turned opportunity into production, Three Dreaded Snake’s counter failed to land. A negative outing from Tyler Shough (-0.16) ballooned the damage, stalling momentum and giving HMB full control of the middle game.

pages.title: The Survey Line
pages.text:

MATCHUP IV
THE LLC VS MUD DOGS
THE SURVEY LINE
ONE SIDE SEES PROPERTY. THE OTHER SEES HOME.
The LLC doesn’t see a swamp. He sees potential. While others see mud and mosquitoes, he sees acreage, opportunity, and a chance to build something permanent. Armed with blueprints, survey stakes, and a vision bigger than the bayou, The LLC draws a line where chaos has always ruled.

But the Mud Dogs don’t do property lines. This is their home — a living, breathing swamp that remembers every trespasser. They don’t just defend turf; they consume it. The deeper you go, the meaner it gets. And nothing in this water stays clean.

This week, the survey line goes down. One side is here to claim the land. The other side is here to make sure it never happens.

The LLC pushed into Mud Dogs territory and put the survey line down. What started as a hostile environment turned into a dominant statement, as The LLC took control, built early separation and never looked back.

The Mud Dogs fought, as they always do, and the swamp is still very much alive. But this week, The LLC owned the ground.

pages.title: The Giant Falls
pages.text:
WEEK FIVE
MATCHUP VI
PAGE 16
THE GIANT FALLS
DUCKHOOK TOPPLES THE ARSENAL CENTAUR
Arsenal
THE COUNTRY CLUB OF JACKSON

At the Country Club of Jackson, Dr. Duckhook delivered a statement win, toppling D0nkey K0ng 184.91 to 141.44 in a stunning David-versus-Goliath upset. The Arsenal Centaur entered as the heavy favorite, but Duckhook had other plans, outplaying the giant on fantasy’s grandest stage.

Drake Maye exploded for 49.16, setting the tone with a jaw-dropping performance, and Jahmyr Gibbs added 41.20 to keep the pressure on all night. Duckhook’s balanced firepower proved too much, overwhelming the mighty Arsenal Centaur.

In the end, it was the underdog’s night. With a cold cigar and a steely stare, Dr. Duckhook reminded the league that any giant can fall.

pages.title: Final Word
pages.text:
PRO SCHEMIN’ FOOTBALL LEAGUE
WEEK 5 | FINAL WORD
FINAL WORD
STILL A LONG ROAD TO THE KINGDOM
Five weeks in, and the realm looks nothing like we imagined — and everything like Pro Schemin’.
The Hill has a new ruler, but the crown is heavy and the ground is still shifting. The trade winds are back. The machines are humming. The outlaws are riding. The swamp is waiting. And half the league sits at 2-3, reminding everyone that one week can change everything.
This isn’t a sprint. It’s a 14-week war across mountains, lakes, swamps, and city streets. Every win matters. Every move echoes. And every owner still believes.
SAME OBSESSION. FANTASY LIVES HERE.

THE JOURNEY CONTINUES

WHAT WE KNOW
The Hill is alive, but no one is safe.
The middle is a bloodbath — seven teams at 2-3.
The moves are coming. Trade season is open.
Every owner still has a path.
The Belt still waits.
And the kingdom is far from settled.

WHAT COMES NEXT
Week 6 brings new battlegrounds, renewed rivalries, and a Game of the Week that could reshape the season: D0nkey K0ng vs. Red Leopards. The Hill meets the hunt. Momentum meets a resurgence. The realm will be watching.
DIFFERENT ROADS. SAME DESTINATION.

A FINAL NOTE
This league isn’t just about points. It’s about stories, pride, and the places that make Pro Schemin’ legendary. Six more weeks separate contenders from pretenders, and every owner still has a chance to change their story.
Keep making moves. Keep the receipts. Keep the trash talk. Keep the fantasy alive.
SAME OBSESSION. FANTASY LIVES HERE.
